source: Engine persistence contract: preserve the existing RTS cleanup lifetime across save/restore. This is not a new Harpoon combat rule.
scope: hv2026-rts-v4 only; archived Legacy/v2/v3 cleanup and wire shape remain unchanged
missing_clock_policy: A Full-profile native sink records its actual death tick. Other retired bodies acquire a persistent clock on first cleanup. Never use the skipped emission cache as authoritative saved state.
